Report Specifications
FCIS_14.4.0.0.0$ASNB_R2
May 2021
Functional Specifications
Introduction

Background
As part of PNB upgrade, all the existing Branch Online Report (BOR) reports mentioned below are required to be developed using Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher (BIP) to meet business reporting needs.
T-1 Cash Cheque Analysis Report
T-2 Teller Transaction Summary
T-3 Teller Transaction Detail

T-4 Cheque/Money Transfer/Debit Card Txn Report
T-5 Transaction Summary Report - Corporate Client
B-1 Cash Cheque Analysis Report
B-2 Teller Cash Balance Report
B-3 Branch Transaction Summary

B-4 Summary Transaction Approved By Supervisor
B-5 Transaction Summary By Teller
B-6 Transaction Summary By Fund
B-7 Transaction Summary By Time
B-8 Branch Cash / Non-Cash Transaction Summary

B-9 Branch Transaction Detail Report
B-10 Cheque/Money Transfer/ Debit Card Txn Detail
B-11 Fund Switching Transaction
B-12 Account Registration/Closure Details
B-14 Pending Cheque/Money Transfer Status

B-15 Fund Financial Plan Transaction
B-16 Transaction Summary Report - Corporate Client
Organization of the Document
This document details the enhancements by means of requirement overview and functional approach along with assumptions / screenshots.
Acronyms and Abbreviations

References
Since this is an upgrade, there is no reference document applicable.
T-1 CASH CHEQUE ANALYSIS REPORT
Requirements Overview
This Report is to extract cash/cheque analysis details for the current application date by the Teller in the specific Branch.

This report will be executed from FCIS Screen and no automation/scheduling of this report is required.
Report should be designed and generated in PDF Format.
No Signature is embedded in this report.
Functional Enhancements
This new report will be developed, and the generation will be based on Report ID selection by Teller.

Report Properties
Report Parameterization
Report ID
UTRPT001

Report ID Logic
Read-Only Parameters

Input Parameters
Report Conditions
As this report will be opened by the Teller the criteria is by default the Teller ID who triggers the report and the branch code will be respective branch.
Report Order By
Report content is grouped by below field values

REMARKS, BRANCH CODE, TRANSACTION DATE, USER ID and MOVEMENT TIME.
Report Pagination
NA
Report Fields
Cash/Cheque Analysis Report

Cash Movement between Till and Vault
Denomination
Field Value Derivation/Calculations Logic
Database View
Report Template

As this report will be opened by the Teller the criteria is by default the Teller ID who triggers the report and the branch code will be respective branch.
Fields\data inside the tag < xxxx > are dynamically derived\populated.
Screenshot
Report Layout
Report Logic

Track the report triggered by User i.e. insert the details into the Reporting table with the details like REPORT ID, Report User ID, Report Branch Code, Report Date, Triggered User ID, Branch Code, Module ID, Status, Report Triggered date and Start time.
The Report generation date would be Application date.
Get the Report file name based on the logic mentioned below. 
<Report ID> || <Report Type> || <Branch Code> || <User ID> || <Report Date in 'DDMONYYYY' format> || <System Date in 'HH24MISS' format> ||  <Report Sequence> || . || <Report Format>
Example :
UTRPT001TASNBWI001ANIL30APR20211653472685.

Populate the Report Header.
For the Logged in Teller ID and Branch code, check if there is any cash ledger exists. If exists then, get the GST collection on Financial Transactions, GST on Non-Financial collection, Cheque Redemptions.
Populate the Report Details.
Populate the Cash movement details such as Balance Brought Forward, From Vault , To Vault , Cash Collection ,SST Collection ,Cash Redemption ,Cash In Hand and Cheque Redemption.
Assumptions

All report level parameters will be configured with language code as 1033 i.e., English (United States).

Populate the Report Header.
Populate the Report Details.
Populate all the Transaction details into the Reporting table based on the Branch code, Report Date, maker ID, and Transaction date between Report date and tomorrow’s application date.
For each Fund, populate all the summary of Transactions such as Inflow, Outflow, Fee details, Initial Khairat details and other Non-Cash details between current application date and tomorrow’s application date by the Teller in the specific Branch.

For Outflows\Redemptions, exclude the retype such as ('LF', 'E3', 'CL').
Assumptions
All report level parameters will be configured with language code as 1033 i.e., English (United States).
